title: Authenticated Tracking graphing SQL injection through duplicated department IDs
authentication: authenticated staff session with Tracking graphing access
provenance: Independent source review plus runtime timing proof against the pinned vulnerable commit; the public advisory and official v30.0.01 diff are used only as ground-truth comparison.
attack_chain: graphing.php reads $_POST['gibbonDepartmentIDs'] and $_POST['dataType'] without sanitizing the ID array.
The only pre-query validation checks dataType against the literal strings attainment/effort; array members remain untouched.
The code constructs named PDO placeholders from each array member and also appends the same value to the SQL predicate text.

Because the placeholder name and the SQL fragment are derived from the same value, a duplicate ID such as 0005 and '0005 OR SLEEP(10)' reuses :department_MB0005 and appends OR SLEEP(10) to the predicate.
A valid department with no matching fixture row makes both department predicates false, so the injected SLEEP is evaluated; the response is delayed by about 20 seconds.

source_evidence.observation: gibbonPersonIDs, gibbonDepartmentIDs and dataType are assigned directly from $_POST.
The guard only checks non-null values and whether dataType is attainment or effort; it does not validate the ID array.
Each department/person ID becomes both an array key for the parameter map and a concatenated fragment of the SQL predicate; duplicate IDs create the reusable placeholder plus an appended expression.
$departmentExtra_MB, $departmentExtra_IA, $personExtra_MB and $personExtra_IA are interpolated into the SQL text before PDO prepare/execute.

remediation: Sanitize $_POST through Validator, coerce both ID arrays with sanitizeArrayIDs(), and sanitize $dataType with sanitizeAlphaNumeric() before it is used in dynamic SQL identifiers. The official v30.0.01 fix applies exactly these controls.
ground_truth: The official v30.0.01 diff adds Validator and sanitizeArrayIDs/sanitizeAlphaNumeric in modules/Tracking/graphing.php, and adds the corresponding Validator methods.
